description: This file defines TypeScript interfaces and functions for handling structured payloads related to a QQ bot, including parsing, encoding, and decoding cron reminder and media payloads.

methods.name: parseQQBotPayload
methods.description: Parses a string to extract a structured QQ bot payload, returning success or error details.

methods.name: encodePayloadForCron
methods.description: Encodes a CronReminderPayload into a base64 string prefixed for cron message storage.

methods.name: decodeCronPayload
methods.description: Decodes a stored cron payload string back into a CronReminderPayload object, with error handling.

methods.name: isCronReminderPayload
methods.description: Type guard to check if a payload is a CronReminderPayload.

methods.name: isMediaPayload
methods.description: Type guard to check if a payload is a MediaPayload.
